newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso up 3.25 as coffee earnings flood in.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso up 3.25 as coffee earnings flood in.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 3.25 pesos to close at 1,073.75 against the dollar as coffee export earnings flooded into the money markets, interbank traders said.

"A lot of coffee earnings and a large slice of foreign investment came into the market. There was some demand from the iron and steel industry and a shipping company, but dollar supply was about three times higher than demand," one trader said.
Another trader said he expected coffee export earnings to continue flowing into the market in the next few days.
The peso opened at 1,076.5, hit an intraday high of 1,073.5 and a low of 1,077.1. Dealers reported 359 trades worth a total $174 million -- close to the daily average.
